regions.label: Serif masthead with tagline, Text size A/A+/A++ toggle, and a top nav row with an underlined active item
Full-width green 'Where you are' bar with CURRENT ISSUE pill, a sentence naming the issue being read, and a Browse the archive button
Eyebrow 'This month's issue', big serif H1, publication meta line, double rule
Front-page lead story: kicker, huge serif headline, dek, byline, illustrated photo with Enlarge button (opens lightbox), caption, excerpt, Read the full story button
One more front-page story teaser (kicker, serif headline, dek)
'Inside this issue' contents grouped by section headings with tiny story counts; each row has page number, serif headline link, dek and byline, separated by hairlines
'Find more' aside: archive search box with hint, holiday events date list, 'Looking for an old story?' panel, and tinted 'New to this site?' help panel explaining the colored bars
White footer with two plain paragraphs about volunteers and scanned-text caveats

patterns.rationale: Sidebar boxes are bordered panels of mixed content rather than item summaries; story teasers are unboxed list rows. Could be read as cards by others.

evidence.note: Bordered sidebar panel, not an item card
Underlined active item is a nav link to separate routes, not tabs
Text-size control exists, but this page is an issue index, not a long-form reading surface

structure.layout: two-column newspaper-style page: masthead + top nav, full-width colored status bar, then 860px main column (issue title, lead story, contents list grouped by section) beside a 340px sidebar of bordered panels; plain footer

aesthetics.typography: Georgia (bold serif) for masthead, H1, headlines, deks and story body; system-ui sans for nav, eyebrows/kickers (uppercase, letter-spaced), bylines, sidebar, buttons and banner text
aesthetics.typeScale: High contrast: masthead/H1 57px Georgia 700, lead headline 49px, secondary headline 28px, contents headlines ~21px; dek 25px serif; body 17-19px; nav 18px/600; kickers 14-15px uppercase tracked; generous 17px+ base for older readers

notes: Accessibility-first community newspaper: large base type, A/A+/A++ text-size toggle, skip link, underlined links, 2px button outlines. Wayfinding via a color-coded 'Where you are' bar (green = current issue, brown = older issue) explained in a sidebar help panel with inline color swatches. Warm cream paper background, Georgia headlines with brown uppercase kickers ('FRONT PAGE · PAGE 1'), double rule under the issue title, hairline dividers between contents rows, page numbers ('p. 2') in a left gutter like a printed table of contents. Lead photo is a flat vector illustration with a dark 'Enlarge' chip that opens a lightbox dialog. No shadows, no gradients, no icons.
